strings.GND_Mongoose_Revolution_desc:
Running with his posse of thugs, colloquially known as the Mongoose Legion, Eric Gairy had seized power in Grenada under the sole mandate of removing East Caribbean presence from the island due to its continuous overreach under Eric Williams' direction. Supported primarily by filibusters, mercenaries, as well as a fair share of disgruntled, underpaid police officers, Gairy's right to leadership is far from a popularly supported one.

Though the entire island has been placed under a state of emergency due to supposed evidence of imminent retaliation from Trinidadian forces, Gairy's current dictatorial rule remains merely moments away from slipping if he ever fails to satisfy his base.
strings.GND_Grenadian_Connection_desc: Eric Gairy's revolution was not a purely grassroots one, rumors abound of his connections to foreign intelligence from America to Iberia and general association with organized crime. Whether an economy can maintain itself on dark money and smuggling is an open question and a key driver of Gairy's quest for legitimacy.
